idea-plugin.name: Dependency License Lens
idea-plugin.description:
Dependency License Lens

Shows license information for project dependencies directly in the IDE. Parses build files (Gradle, Maven, npm), resolves license info, and provides a compliance dashboard. Flags potentially problematic licenses (GPL in commercial projects, etc.).

Features

  • License scanning — automatically detect licenses for all dependencies
  • Risk indicators — 🟢 permissive, 🟡 weak copyleft, 🔴 strong copyleft
  • Compliance dashboard — overview of all dependencies and their licenses
  • Policy enforcement — block problematic licenses (e.g., GPL in commercial projects)
  • Multi-format — supports Gradle, Maven, and npm build files

Freemium

Free: scan and view licenses. Paid: custom policies, export, CI integration.
